blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House impeachment prosecution team adviser and spokesperson Ace Barbers said Saturday that the unexplained wealth allegation against Vice President Sara Duterte was, in his personal assessment, the strongest of the three impeachment articles pursued by the prosecution. Speaking at the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City, Barbers cited extensive documentary evidence obtained from government agencies and financial institutions to support the charge. “In my personal opinion, and I do not mind if the prosecution team disagrees with me, I believe the unexplained wealth charge is the strongest,” Barbers said. “Because data and documents do not […]...
